title: Spacetime Shuffle #3 A Trilogy Alpha Productions 1990 Limited Series Last Issue
conditionDescription: Front clean and glossy with light spine wear; small chips and a crease along the right edge of the back cover. Staples intact. See photos.
descriptionText:
Spacetime Shuffle #3 of the 3-issue limited series (Alpha Productions, 1990) - the final issue of the trilogy. $1.95 cover price.

Back cover: full-color pin-up with the Alpha Productions logo.

See photos for condition. Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
